_comment: C4 regression gate. Consumed by `cmd/piano-distance --thresholds` and by `just gate-c4`.
A number under `max` is ENFORCED: the run fails (exit 2) when the measured metric
exceeds it. A `null` means NOT YET CALIBRATED - the metric is listed so its existence
is visible, but it is deliberately not enforced. Calibrating one later is a one-line
diff (replace the null with a number), not a new file. Any key here that is not a
float64 field of analysis.Metrics is an ERROR, so typos cannot silently disable a gate.
Thresholds are the values measured on 2026-08-21 plus roughly 8-10% headroom. They are
a regression fence, not a quality target: tighten them whenever a fit genuinely improves.
SPECTRAL CAVEAT: spectral_rmse_db is gated as a RAW dB value, which is a real regression
signal. The NORMALISED spectral component of the LEGACY score is a different matter - at
58.2 dB against analysis.NormSpectral = 30.0 it is saturated, clamp01 pins it at 1.0, and
it therefore contributes a constant to `score` with no gradient for the optimizer. Every
preset in the repo saturates it (measured population 51.5-71.3 dB).
That is now deliberate, not unfixed. Norms are per-profile (analysis/norms.go): legacy-v1
keeps LegacyNorms() so this gate and every recorded score stay comparable, while every
other profile carries CalibratedNorms() and does not saturate. This file gates the legacy
score on purpose - it is the number the recorded measurements below were taken with.

note: Measured against pristine HEAD as well as the working tree; both give the identical
score, so these numbers are the current behaviour of analysis.Compare and not a
regression introduced by the metric work.
